Another vault of the same owner is alrea.en: Another vault of the same owner is already called “%@”. The name is allowed, but the two will be hard to tell apart.
Another vault of the same owner is alrea.it: Un altro vault dello stesso proprietario si chiama già “%@”. Il nome è consentito, ma sarà difficile distinguerli.

Its wallets, envelopes, transactions and.en: Its wallets, envelopes, transactions and recurring templates go with it. It disappears from every device of every member as they sync; the server keeps its history only to bring the deletion to them. This cannot be undone.
Its wallets, envelopes, transactions and.it: Con lui se ne vanno i wallet, le buste, le transazioni e le ricorrenze che contiene. Sparisce da ogni dispositivo di ogni membro man mano che si sincronizzano; il server ne conserva la cronologia solo per portare loro la cancellazione. Non si può annullare.

New accounts need 3 to 32 characters: a–.en: New accounts need 3 to 32 characters: a–z, 0–9, “_”, “.” or “-”.
New accounts need 3 to 32 characters: a–.it: I nuovi account richiedono da 3 a 32 caratteri: a–z, 0–9, “_”, “.” o “-”.

New accounts need a password of at least.en: New accounts need a password of at least 8 characters.
New accounts need a password of at least.it: I nuovi account richiedono una password di almeno 8 caratteri.

The current password is not correct..en: The current password is not correct.
The current password is not correct..it: La password attuale non è corretta.

The new password needs at least 8 charac.en: The new password needs at least 8 characters.
The new password needs at least 8 charac.it: La nuova password deve avere almeno 8 caratteri.

The owner stopped sharing these vaults w.en: The owner stopped sharing these vaults with you, or they were removed from the server. What was synced before stays here, read-only, until you remove it.
The owner stopped sharing these vaults w.it: Il proprietario ha smesso di condividere questi vault con te, oppure sono stati tolti dal server. Quello che era già sincronizzato resta qui, in sola lettura, finché non lo rimuovi.

The two new passwords do not match..en: The two new passwords do not match.
The two new passwords do not match..it: Le due nuove password non coincidono.

This vault is no longer shared with you..en: This vault is no longer shared with you.
This vault is no longer shared with you..it: Questo vault non è più condiviso con te.

en.one: Too many attempts. Try again in %lld minute.
en.other: Too many attempts. Try again in %lld minutes.

Too many attempts. Try again later..en: Too many attempts. Try again later.

You can read this vault but not change i.en: You can read this vault but not change it.
You can read this vault but not change i.it: Puoi leggere questo vault ma non modificarlo.

Your changes still waiting to sync are s.en: Your changes still waiting to sync are sent first. Then the vault is removed from this Mac and you stop receiving its changes. Its owner and the other members keep it; only the owner can share it with you again.
Your changes still waiting to sync are s.it: Prima vengono inviate le tue modifiche ancora in attesa. Poi il vault viene rimosso da questo Mac e smetti di riceverne le modifiche. Il proprietario e gli altri membri lo conservano; solo il proprietario può condividerlo di nuovo con te.

Your login could not be saved in the Key.en: Your login could not be saved in the Keychain; you'll need to log in again next time.
Your login could not be saved in the Key.it: Non è stato possibile salvare l'accesso nel Portachiavi; la prossima volta dovrai accedere di nuovo.

Your other devices will be signed out..en: Your other devices will be signed out.
Your other devices will be signed out..it: I tuoi altri dispositivi verranno disconnessi.

Your password was changed. Your other de.en: Your password was changed. Your other devices were signed out and need to log in again with the new password.
Your password was changed. Your other de.it: La password è stata cambiata. I tuoi altri dispositivi sono stati disconnessi e devono accedere di nuovo con la nuova password.

Your role in this vault only lets you re.en: Your role in this vault only lets you read it.
Your role in this vault only lets you re.it: Il tuo ruolo in questo vault ti permette solo di leggerlo.
